push.mrTitlePlaceholder: Optional — defaults to the branch name
push.directWarning: Pushes your HEAD straight to this remote branch — no review. Use for your own topic branches.

resolver.binaryHelp: This is a binary file — it can't be merged line by line. Resolve it on disk with your tool of choice, then stage it here.
resolver.malformedMarkers: The conflict markers in this file are incomplete or malformed. Resolve it by hand below, then Mark resolved.
resolver.noMarkers: No conflict markers found — this file looks already resolved on disk. Stage it to finish.
resolver.blockedByMarker: A resolved side still contains a conflict-marker line — use Edit on that block, or Edit raw, to remove it.
resolver.markResolvedTitle: Write the resolved file and stage it

resolver.stillHasMarkers: The file still contains conflict markers — remove them before marking resolved.

resolver.acceptAllIncomingTitle: Accept the incoming (theirs) side for every conflict
resolver.editRawTitle: Edit the whole file by hand
resolver.showBaseTitle: Show the common ancestor (base) for this conflict
resolver.acceptBothTitle: Keep the current side, then the incoming side
resolver.editBlockTitle: Hand-edit the resolved text for this conflict

connDialog.description: Connect a GitLab instance to browse repositories, view the commit graph and (on desktop) clone locally. A personal access token is encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM and never returned in the clear.
connDialog.providerNote: GitLab or GitHub. GitHub connections show repositories, branches, history and files, and clone and push; pull requests and Actions come next.
connDialog.baseUrlNote: Your GitLab host — https://gitlab.com or a self-managed instance.
connDialog.authOauthNote: Reads run as the caller — each user links their own GitLab account in Settings.
connDialog.authPatNote: A stored token (api scope) shared by everyone granted this connection.
connDialog.thisDeviceDesc: Store on the embedded desktop BE. Required to clone repositories locally.
connDialog.patchmanServerDesc: Store on the team backend so grantees can browse it too.
connDialog.bothBackendsNote: The connection is saved to BOTH backends — the token is encrypted with each BE's own key. Pick which one it defaults to.
connDialog.patRequired: A personal access token is required
connDialog.patHelp: Create one in GitLab: avatar → Edit profile → Access Tokens (<path>{{host}}/-/user_settings/personal_access_tokens</path>). The scopes it needs are listed under the field. It's shown only once — copy it immediately.
connDialog.patHelpAria: How to get a personal access token
connDialog.tokenExpired: GitLab says this token has expired. Create a new one and paste it here.
connDialog.tokenRevoked: GitLab says this token was revoked. Create a new one and paste it here.
connDialog.tokenInvalid: GitLab did not accept this token. Check that it belongs to this GitLab and was copied in full.
connDialog.tokenScope: The token is missing a scope it needs — see the list under the token field (usually api).
connDialog.patScopes: Scopes: api covers everything PatchMan does — browsing, merge request comments and approvals, clone, pull and push. Read-only: read_api + read_repository. A project or group token also needs read_repository (clone) and write_repository (push). Don't give it sudo, and use your own account, not an admin. CI/CD: read_api shows pipelines, logs and schedules; running, retrying or cancelling needs api. Reading CI/CD variables also needs the Maintainer role on the project.
connDialog.providerNoteGithub: Repositories, branches, history, files, clone and push. Pull requests and Actions come in the next versions.
connDialog.patHelpGithub: Create one on GitHub: Settings → Developer settings → Personal access tokens (<path>{{host}}/settings/tokens</path>). A fine-grained token can be limited to some repositories. It's shown only once — copy it immediately.
connDialog.patScopesGithub: Fine-grained token: Contents (read, or read and write to push) and Metadata (read). Classic token: repo; for public repositories only, public_repo.

shareDialog.title: Share "{{name}}"
shareDialog.description: Recipients act through this connection without ever seeing the stored token. Read = browse repositories, commit graph & diffs. Write is reserved for a later revision.

sidebar.title: Git connections
sidebar.deleteDescription: The connection and every grant under it are removed from all backends. This does not touch the GitLab project itself. This cannot be undone.

errors.markResolved: Could not mark the file resolved
errors.pull: Could not pull the latest changes
errors.networkRemote: Can't reach the PatchMan server. Check your VPN or network connection.
errors.networkLocal: Can't reach PatchMan's backend on this computer. Restart the app if this keeps happening.

pull.title: Pull the latest from the remote (fast-forward)
pull.successDesc: The local clone is now up to date with the remote.

ci.selectPipeline: Pick a pipeline to see its jobs.
ci.selectJob: Pick a job to see its log.
ci.varsNeedWrite: CI/CD variables are often secrets, so they're shown only to people with write access on this connection. GitLab also requires the Maintainer role on the project.
ci.varsHint: Values stay hidden until you show them, one at a time (each look is recorded). Masked values are shown to Maintainers; hidden ones GitLab never returns.
ci.varsPlaceholder_gh: Workflow inputs, one per line: name=value ({{inputs}})
ci.noSchedules_gh: No workflow has an on: schedule trigger.
ci.schedulesHint_gh: Schedules come from each workflow's on: schedule (UTC); change them in the workflow file. "Run now" needs workflow_dispatch.
ci.noDispatchable: No workflow here can be run by hand — add workflow_dispatch to its on: block.
ci.varsHint_gh: Variable values stay hidden until you show them, one at a time (each look is recorded). Secrets only list their names — GitHub never returns a secret's value.

update.title: Update Project…
update.noUpstream: {{branch}} has no upstream branch. Push it first, or check out a branch that tracks a remote one.
update.mergeHint: Merge the incoming commits into your branch (a merge commit when histories diverged).
update.rebaseHint: Replay your local commits on top of the incoming ones (linear history).
update.ffHint: Only move the branch forward; stop if it has diverged.
update.autostash: Stash local changes and re-apply them after updating

remotes.title: Manage Remotes…
remotes.hint: The connection's token is only ever sent to origin's host (🔒). Other remotes need public access.
remotes.removeBody: Its remote-tracking branches are removed from this clone. Nothing changes on the server.

vcs.smartBody: Smart Checkout stashes your changes, switches branch and re-applies them. If they conflict, you resolve them in Changes.
vcs.checkoutRevisionLabel: Tag, commit hash or any ref
vcs.deleteBody: Only the local branch is deleted.
vcs.forceDeleteBody: Its unmerged commits will only be reachable through the reflog. Delete anyway?
vcs.opResolved: All conflicts resolved — continue to finish
vcs.abortBody: Your branch goes back to where it was before; resolved files are discarded.
vcs.viewingHint: History and Browse show this ref. Click to go back to the checked-out branch.

pushDialog.title: Push Commits
pushDialog.forceBody: Commits on the remote that you don't have are discarded. --force-with-lease refuses if someone pushed since your last fetch.
pushDialog.mrOpened: Pushed, and the merge request is open.
pushDialog.rejected: Push rejected: the remote has commits you don't. Update first.

vcs.diffWorkTreeTitle: Diff between {{ref}} and the working tree
vcs.diffWorkTreeSame: The working tree matches this branch.
vcs.trackUnset: {{name}} no longer tracks a remote branch
vcs.pushBranchNew: {{remote}}/{{target}} doesn't exist yet: it will be created.
vcs.pushBranchNothing: Nothing to push — the remote branch already has these commits.
vcs.worktreeHint: A worktree is a second folder of the same repository, on its own branch. It opens in a new Git tab.
vcs.branchDiverged: {{name}} and its remote branch have both moved on. Check it out and use Update Project to merge or rebase.
vcs.branchNoUpstream: {{name}} doesn't track a remote branch. Set a tracked branch first.
vcs.deleteRemoteBody: The branch is removed from the server for everyone. Your local branch, if any, stays.
vcs.deleteTagBody: Only the tag in this folder is deleted; a tag already pushed stays on the remote.

resolver3.pendingTitle: Unresolved — shows the common ancestor. Take a side or type the result.
resolver3.windowHint: {{resolved}} of {{total}} conflicts resolved. The 3-pane merge opens in its own window.
resolver3.title: Merge {{path}}
resolver3.filesLeft_other: {{count}} conflicted files — the next opens when this one is resolved

mr.reviewModeHint: Comments stay pending until you submit the review

tree.title: Project
tree.deleteFolderBody: The folder and everything in it is deleted from the working tree (tracked files show as deleted in Changes).
tree.deleteFileBody: The file is deleted from the working tree (a tracked file shows as deleted in Changes).

workspace.annotateHint: Show who last changed each line (git blame)
workspace.autoSavePaused: Auto save is paused for this file so the other change isn't lost. Press ⌘S to overwrite it, or close and reopen the file to load the disk version.
workspace.overwriteBody: Another program changed this file after you opened it. Overwriting replaces that change with your version.
